svg.title: 01 // System Overview & Identity — Susatwik Manuri
svg.desc: Executive profile of Susatwik Manuri featuring large authentic seated photograph, architectural profile, and foundational engineering pillars.

g.text: CSE UNDERGRADUATE · SASI INSTITUTE OF TECH & ENG
B.Tech Computer Science student at Sasi Institute of Technology & Engineering,
building full-stack platforms, agentic AI systems, and scalable backends.
Algorithms drive my edge-case rigor; distributed systems define my service boundaries.
Proven competitive discipline applied directly to backend algorithmic efficiency, complex graph models, and optimal data structure design.
Career Compass, RecoveryMate, RestaurantFlow & Pawdentify. Built with full architectural blueprints, relational schemas (Supabase RLS), and live user interfaces.
Autonomous tool execution, multi-stage scoring pipelines, and clinical document chunking that replace hallucination-prone chat wrappers with deterministic outputs.
BASE: ANDHRA PRADESH, IN · ACADEMIC: SASI TECH (CSE) · STATUS: OPEN TO ROLES
